name: shell
description: Shell script execution or shell command execution
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: Inline command run with '<shell> -c'; lists and objects are passed as JSON text. Give either command or script.

arguments.name: script
arguments.description: Shell script file run with the selected shell. Give either command or script.

arguments.name: shell
arguments.description: Shell executable to use (the first of bash, sh, zsh found when omitted).

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: Positional arguments passed to the command or script ($1, $2, ...).

arguments.name: cwd
arguments.description: Working directory the command or script runs in.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Seconds after which the command is stopped.

arguments.name: env
arguments.description: Extra environment variables for the command or script.
